versions.subject: feat: update certutil rules
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\certutil.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'CertUtil.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        # Decode Base64
        - '-decode '
        - '/decode '
        # Decode Hex
        - '-decodehex '
        - '/decodehex '
condition: all of selection_*
